text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hishi Amazon is defeated by Narita Brian 
at the Arima Kinen. People begin to 
whisper and wonder if the day will ever 
come when she can defeat the "Monster"...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Hishi Amazon won't give up. She 
vows to take her revenge against Narita 
Brian at next year's Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After discussing it with her Trainer, 
Hishi Amazon set her sights on the Osaka 
Hai as her next goal. Naturally, she was 
aiming for nothing less than first 
place...!
